# Indoor Radio Map Dataset

**Aliases:** ICASSP 2025 Indoor Radio Map Challenge Dataset

A large indoor path-loss radio-map dataset generated by intelligent ray tracing across 25 geometries, multiple frequency bands, and multiple directional antenna patterns.
